items.text: A divider drag whose panes keep showing the previous size now says verdict=stale instead of smooth.
A fold glide at 120 Hz now misses 7-9 frames of ~987, and the strip face's paint is broken down per phase in the stack trace; what is left of the fold's cost is filed as T2940 and T2941.
A divider drag's region hold now lasts through the glide it leaves settling, so the panes' shapes are re-cut once when it lands instead of on every settling frame.
